answer: Build standing as a trellis of live dependencies: an identity earns weight only while specific, independent others genuinely rely on its continuing work and can prune the strand at any moment. Each strand carries a distinct pigment — a non-transferable trace of real use, not a vote — so a sybil ring's self-reliance stays colourless. Like a lotus rooted in one place, an identity cannot be everywhere at once; faking hundreds of dependents means maintaining hundreds of real services, which costs more than the standing is worth.
